_comment: Quotes from the patron saints, shown in English under each portrait in the patrons section. The Español button translates them.

hildegard.quote: Music softens hard hearts, draws forth the tears of compunction, and calls down the Holy Spirit.
hildegard.name: Saint Hildegard of Bingen
hildegard.alt: Saint Hildegard of Bingen receiving a vision
hildegard.role: Composer and Doctor of the Church. Feast, September 17

romero.quote: The glory of God is the poor person fully alive.
romero.name: Saint Óscar Romero
romero.source: Address at the University of Louvain, February 2, 1980
romero.role: Archbishop of San Salvador and martyr. Feast, March 24

guadalupe.quote: Am I not here, I who am your mother?
guadalupe.name: Our Lady of Guadalupe
guadalupe.source: To Saint Juan Diego, Nican Mopohua, 1531
guadalupe.alt: Our Lady of Guadalupe, the image on Saint Juan Diego's tilma
guadalupe.role: Patroness of the Americas. Feast, December 12
